rounds.text: Gravity (India) Ltd is exceptionally under-appreciated by the market, trading at a P/E of just 5.86x [E1] compared to a sector benchmark of 18.92x [E6], while delivering staggering financial performance highlighted by a 10-year compounded sales growth of 25% [E14] and a TTM compounded profit growth of 1568% [E21]. The company's profitability metrics are elite, boasting a reported ROE of 151.0% [E13] and an ROCE of 100.5% against a sector benchmark of just 7.76% [E10]. This fundamental strength is entirely disconnected from the share price, as evidenced by a discounted cash flow intrinsic value pointing toward a massive margin of safety [E43, E44], and a reverse DCF implying the current price anticipates negative growth when the business is actually accelerating [E45]. Furthermore, the company operates with a conservatively financed balance sheet, carrying a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.13x [E38] with borrowings reduced to Rs 2 Cr [E39], all while benefiting from a supportive sector tailwind in textiles [E67, E69]. Conceded: promoter holding has decreased over the last 3 years to 6.05% [E41, E61] and cash conversion stands at 0.00x for Mar 2026 [E34].
